sanskrit: indra jīva sūrya jīva devā jīvā jīvyāsam aham | sarvam āyur jīvyāsam ||
english: Indra, live! Sun, live! May the gods live! May I live! May I live out the full span of life!

sanskrit: anābhūr asmi naitave tantyāṃ baddho divi śritaḥ | āhā tvā nirṛtaye ||
english: I am unborn for destruction; bound to the cord, I rest in the sky. I summon you away from Nirṛti.

sanskrit: rantir asi ramatir asi | saṃ śrutena rādhiṣīya mā śrutena vi rādhiṣi ||
english: You are Rantī, you are Ramatī. May I succeed through what is heard; may I not fail through what is heard.

sanskrit: darśo 'si darśato 'si viśvataḥ saṃdṛṣṭaḥ | somo asi rudro asi ||
english: You are Darśa, you are Darśata, seen on every side. You are Soma, you are Rudra.

sanskrit: taṃ tvā yaṃ devā aṃśum āpyāyanti taṃ tvā yam ādityā aṃśum āpyāyanti | taṃ tvā yam akṣitam akṣitaye pibanti sa naḥ somaḥ pra tirad dīrgham āyuḥ ||
english: You — that shoot of yours which the gods cause to swell, you — that shoot of yours which the Ādityas cause to swell, you — that inexhaustible one which they drink for inexhaustibility — may that Soma extend long life for us.

sanskrit: anyeṣāṃ prāṇenā pyāyasva māsmākaṃ prāṇena | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas tasya prāṇenā pyāyasva ||
english: Swell with the breath of others, not with our breath. With the breath of the one who hates us and whom we hate — with his breath swell.

sanskrit: cid asi samudrayoniḥ śyena ṛtāvān | somapīthopa na ehy arvāṅ rāyaspoṣeṇa prajayā dhanena ||
english: You are indeed born of the ocean, an eagle, keeper of cosmic order. Come hither to the Soma-drinking; come to us with abundance of wealth, with progeny and riches.

sanskrit: svarava stha namo vo mahatām ūrjāyai | parṇāṃ māva gām ||
english: You are self-resounding; homage to your great vigour. Let not the cow wander from the leaves.

sanskrit: apaścāddaghvānnasya bhūyāsam | annādāyānnapataye rudrāya namo agnaye ||
english: May I never fall behind in food. Homage to Rudra, the eater of food, the lord of food, homage to Agni.

sanskrit: yā te vaso vāta iṣuḥ sā ta eṣā | tayā no mṛḍa ||
english: O Vāsava, O Wind, that arrow of yours — here it is. With it be gracious to us.

sanskrit: agnis takmānam apa bādhatām ito varuṇo grāvā marutaḥ pūtadakṣāḥ | barhiṣadaḥ samidhaḥ śośucānās takmanaḥ śocām apa nir nudantu ||
english: May Agni drive the fever away from here; may Varuṇa, the pressing-stone, and the Maruts of purified might — seated on the sacred grass, the kindled fires blazing bright — thrust the burning fever far away.

sanskrit: yo abhyavabhṛṇāyasi svapantam iccha puruṣaṃ śayānam akovidam | sa naḥ sahasravīry- -ānuṣṭhātā śivo bhava ||
english: You who overwhelm — seek out the man lying asleep, stretched out, unknowing. You who perform deeds with a thousandfold power — be gracious to us.

sanskrit: devayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
english: You are a traveller among the gods, you are gracious. Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed creatures; do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed creatures of the one who hates us and whom we hate.

sanskrit: brahmayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
english: You are a traveller among Brahman-power, you are gracious. Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed creatures; do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed creatures of the one who hates us and whom we hate.

sanskrit: annayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
english: You are a traveller among food, you are gracious. Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed creatures; do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed creatures of the one who hates us and whom we hate.

sanskrit: manuṣyayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
english: You are a traveller among human beings, you are gracious. Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed creatures; do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed creatures of the one who hates us and whom we hate.

sanskrit: avabharaṇo nāmāsi devatrā ṇo akṣamāpaḥ | yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ ta āsann api daghmaḥ ||
english: You are called Avabharaṇa; you are the inexhaustible water among the gods for us. The one who hates us and whom we hate — him we have enclosed in your mouth.

sanskrit: yad adosnātā āsuro dīkṣito 'carat | tasya yan malam avāsravat sa hi nāsi tāvad anuṣṭhyā tvā vidma- -arasaṃ vṛścika te viṣam ||
english: When that Asura, unwashed yet consecrated, roamed about, the filth that oozed from him — that is truly what you are. By that same means we know you, having acted in full. O scorpion, your venom is made powerless.

sanskrit: ketuluṅgā nāma te mātā karkaṭaḥ pitā | tat satyam arasaṃ abhaga te viṣam ||
english: Ketuluṅgā is the name of your mother; Karkaṭa is your father. This is the truth: powerless and bereft of fortune is your venom.

sanskrit: dve viṣasya dhāre striyā anyā puṃso anyā | te ubhe arase ||
english: There are two streams of the venom — one belonging to the female, the other to the male. Both of them are made powerless.

sanskrit: viśvavit taṃ naṣṭam anu paśyasi | ado me naṣṭaṃ tan me punar dehi ||
english: O All-knower, you see that which has been lost. That which of mine has been lost — give it back to me.

sanskrit: viśvakarman tat tvam upa gacchasi | ado me naṣṭaṃ tan me punar dehi ||
english: O All-maker, you approach that thing. That which of mine has been lost — give it back to me.

sanskrit: viśvavyacas tat tvayy adhy āhitam | ado me naṣṭaṃ tan me punar dehi ||
english: O All-pervading one, that is deposited in you. That which of mine has been lost — give it back to me.

sanskrit: pari pūṣā purastād dhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam | punar no naṣṭam āyati jīvena bhunajāmahai ||
english: May Pūṣan place his right hand around us from the front. When what was lost returns to us, may we enjoy it with life.

sanskrit: indras tvābhy ait sarpat tat tvā goṣṭha ādadhāt | tad āsrāvasya bheṣajaṃ tad u rogam anīnaśat ||
english: Indra came to you as you crept; he established you in the cow-stall. That is the remedy for the discharge; that indeed has destroyed the disease.

sanskrit: viṣṇor manasā pūte sthaḥ | devo vāṃ savitot punātu ||
english: You two are purified by Viṣṇu's mind. May divine Savitā also purify you both.

sanskrit: viṣṇor manasā pūtam asi devas tvā savitot punātu | acchidreṇa pavitreṇa sahasradhāreṇa supvā ||
english: You are purified by Viṣṇu's mind; may divine Savitā also purify you, with the unbroken filter of a thousand streams, well-filtering.

sanskrit: hṛdā pūtaṃ manasā jātavedo viśvāni devo vayunāni vidvān | saptāsyāni tava yāny agne tebhyo juhomi sa juṣasva havyam ||
english: O Jātavedas, purified by heart and mind, the god who knows all the ways of wisdom — the seven mouths that are yours, O Agni: to them I offer; accept the oblation with favour.

sanskrit: agnāv agnir ity ekā ||
english: "Fire in fire" — thus one saying.

sanskrit: yas te keśām̐ avācīnān krimir vṛhati mūrdhataḥ | prāṇaṃ tasyopa dāśayād vīrut khanati bheṣajī ||
english: Whatever worm tears out the lower hairs of yours from the head — may the healing plant that digs in the earth extinguish that creature's breath.

sanskrit: veda vai te bhaga nāma bhūrir nāmāsi rayir nāma | taṃ tvā bhaga pra viśāmi sa mā bhaga pra viśa | tasmin sahasrakāṇḍena mṛje bhaga tvayi ||
english: I know indeed: Bhaga is your name; you are named Bhūri; you are named Rayi. You — Bhaga — I enter; you, Bhaga, enter me. In that, O Bhaga, I cleanse myself in you with a thousandfold shaft.
